name: Differentiable Silhouette Rendering
definition: A method to render silhouettes by tracking the minimum absolute SDF value along the ray, providing a differentiable approximation of the binary silhouette.
summary: Differentiable Silhouette Rendering computes soft silhouette values from Signed Distance Functions to enable gradient back-propagation, distinguishing itself by focusing on silhouette supervision rather than full photometric rendering.
